canonical_project: Microsoft Project Natick Phase 2 / Northern Isles underwater datacentre

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: 12-rack, 864-server underwater pod deployed June 2018 at EMEC Orkney and retrieved after about two years; Microsoft confirmed in 2024 that Project Natick is no longer active; 0.24MW widely reported for the pod but not in the primary Microsoft page; no new Orkney facility found (checked 2026-08-12).
